entry.title: feat: Supabase magic-link auth, GET /me, and the Eden treaty call fro…
entry.content:
feat: Supabase magic-link auth, GET /me, and the Eden treaty call from the app (M0 part 2) (#9)

* docs(design): specify the login and Me screens and the auth API shapes

* build(supabase): add the local Supabase stack config and scripts

* feat(api): verify Supabase JWTs and serve POST /auth/session and GET /me

The app is now built by createApp({ users, jwt }) in src/app.ts so tests
run against an in-memory users repository with tokens signed in the test;
src/index.ts wires the Drizzle repository and the real verifier and
listens. verifySupabaseJwt is one function that accepts HS256 with
SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET and ES256 against the project's JWKS, because the
local Supabase CLI issues ES256 tokens. Missing, malformed, tampered,
expired, and exp-less tokens are 401; /me before the first
/auth/session upsert is 404.

* feat(mobile): sign in with a Supabase magic link and persist the session

The root layout becomes a Stack with Stack.Protected guards; the two tabs
move under (tabs)/ so /login and /auth/callback live outside NativeTabs.
The Supabase client persists the session with the Supabase Expo guide's
LargeSecureStore (AES key in expo-secure-store, ciphertext in
AsyncStorage) and ties token refresh to app foreground. The callback
completes the implicit-flow deep link with setSession, calls
POST /auth/session, and serializes concurrent link attempts so the newest
link always owns the persisted session.

* feat(mobile): show the user's row from GET /me on the Me screen

* docs: describe auth, the local Supabase stack, and M0 completion

README gains the supabase start step, the env values, and how to read
the magic-link mail from Mailpit, and marks the M0 row done. AGENTS.md
describes auth and /me as present, names the local Supabase stack as a
heavy Docker dependency, and records the redirect-URL pattern rule.

* docs: require a development build for the magic-link callback and add Android emulator hosts

* fix(mobile): use the theme palette for the login error color

* fix(mobile): key the Me query by user id and surface sign-out failures

* fix(mobile): name the missing environment variable accurately

* docs: name the Supabase CLI prerequisite in Getting started

* fix(mobile): never retry a 404 on the Me query so the repair runs once

* docs: set the Auth external URL so a physical device can follow the magic link

entry.title: build: convert to a Bun workspaces monorepo with Elysia API and Drizz…
entry.content:
build: convert to a Bun workspaces monorepo with Elysia API and Drizzle db (M0 part 1)

- Converted the project into a Bun workspaces monorepo to separate the mobile app, API, and database concerns.
- Added an Elysia API with a typed `App` export and `GET /health` endpoint to provide a foundation for backend services and health checks.
- Added a Drizzle database package with the `users` schema, connection factory, inferred types, and initial PostgreSQL migration to establish the data layer.
- Added Docker Compose PostgreSQL support and updated scripts, CI, linting, documentation, and environment templates to support consistent local and automated workflows.

entry.title: build: convert the root into a Bun workspace and move the Expo app to…
entry.content:
build: convert the root into a Bun workspace and move the Expo app to apps/mobile

The root package.json now only declares workspaces (apps/*, packages/*),
the root scripts that fan out with `bun run --filter '@peak-fanout/*'`,
the uuid and esbuild overrides, and the eslint tooling that the root
eslint.config.mjs needs because trunk runs eslint from the root.
bunfig.toml pins the hoisted linker so expo-doctor sees one copy of expo.
The Expo app moves with git mv and is renamed @peak-fanout/mobile; its
lint config stays in place and is extended from the root config.

entry.title: ci: add GitHub Actions workflow with bun run check and trunk check
entry.content:
ci: add GitHub Actions workflow with bun run check and trunk check

Two jobs on push to main and on pull requests: `bun run check`
(typecheck + lint) with Bun pinned through .bun-version, and
`trunk check --all --no-fix` through trunk-action/setup so CI never
formats. Actions are SHA-pinned by pinact with the version tag in a
comment, and dependabot.yml keeps the pins and Bun dependencies current.
